docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,500.00 FILED BY JACKSON RICHARD AS TO DEFENDANT THOMAS COOK TRAVEL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-11-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 00
